title: Piz'wich Data Breach
description: Based on our analysis of the financial statements, revenue for 2026 was 23 million euros, and net income was 3.9 million euros. Piz'wich is a European frozen snack brand owned by the Frostkrone Food Group that specializes in savory "Pizza Pockets" made from crispy wheat dough. Product Range • Microwave Varieties: 8 flavors designed to be crispy and ready to eat in 2 minutes. • Bake-Off-Station / Oven Varieties: 6 flavors topped with grated cheese that bake in 12 to 15 minutes in a conventional oven or bake-off station. Key Highlights • Convenience: Packaged in a handy cardboard box for mess-free eating without needing extra dishes or cleanup. • Company Background: Produced with over 17 years of snack-manufacturing experience, with facilities in Bulgnéville, France, and Rietberg, Germany. • Partnerships: Official snack partner of the German football club Borussia Dortmund (BVB).
